# Dreamer

> Dreamer is a Vercel/Railway-style Platform-as-a-Service. Connect a GitHub repo and get a live URL in minutes — hosted free on Dreamer's cloud, or self-host the entire platform on your own infrastructure.

Dreamer clones a repo, auto-detects its framework, builds it as either a static site or a server-rendered dynamic app, containerizes it, provisions a wildcard subdomain, streams build logs in real time, and redeploys automatically on every push to the production branch (pinned to the exact commit pushed, via a GitHub App webhook — not a polling-based or manual trigger).

Two ways to use it:
- **Free cloud hosting** — sign up and deploy, no infrastructure to manage. Lifetime free for the first 50 users.
- **Self-hosted** — the entire platform (API server, build engine, reverse proxy) is open source and can be run on your own AWS account or local Docker.

Built by Saman Pandey ([github.com/SamanPandey-in](https://github.com/SamanPandey-in)).

- [Self-Hosting Guide](https://dreamer.samanp.xyz/docs/self-hosting): run the entire platform yourself
- [AWS Console Setup Guide](https://dreamer.samanp.xyz/docs/aws-setup): provisioning the AWS resources a self-hosted instance needs
- [Authentication](https://dreamer.samanp.xyz/docs/auth): GitHub OAuth login + GitHub App-based repo access
- [Projects & Import Wizard](https://dreamer.samanp.xyz/docs/projects): connecting a repo and configuring a build
- [Framework Detection](https://dreamer.samanp.xyz/docs/framework-detection): how Dreamer identifies what it's building
- [Deployments Overview](https://dreamer.samanp.xyz/docs/deployments): the deployment lifecycle
- [Static Deployments](https://dreamer.samanp.xyz/docs/deployments/static): static-site build and hosting path
- [Dynamic (SSR) Deployments](https://dreamer.samanp.xyz/docs/deployments/dynamic): server-rendered app build and hosting path
- [Reverse Proxy](https://dreamer.samanp.xyz/docs/reverse-proxy): how requests get routed to the right deployment
- [Wildcard Domains](https://dreamer.samanp.xyz/docs/wildcard-domains): per-project subdomain provisioning
